maps3d-robolectric-testing/com.google.maps.android.robolectric.maps3d.shadows/ShadowGoogleMap3D

ShadowGoogleMap3D

@Implements(value = GoogleMap3D::class)
open class ShadowGoogleMap3D

Robolectric shadow for GoogleMap3D.

Tracks camera state, map mode, locale, UI control placements, listeners, and ID-keyed 3D overlays (Marker, Polyline, Polygon, Model, Popover) with Maps 3D upsert semantics: adding an overlay with an existing id replaces the previous entry in place.
